subtitle.id: Jawaban lengkap atas pertanyaan umum seputar studi internasional, beasiswa, dan prosedur tinggal di Lombok.
subtitle.en: Direct answers to key inquiries regarding international admission, visa regulations, and student life in Lombok.

q.id: Apakah Universitas Mataram menyediakan beasiswa untuk mahasiswa internasional?
q.en: Does Universitas Mataram offer scholarships for international students?

a.id: Ya, mahasiswa internasional dapat mendaftar melalui beasiswa Kemitraan Negara Berkembang (KNB) dari Pemerintah Indonesia, beasiswa bilateral, atau program bebas biaya kuliah parsial dari UNRAM sesuai kualifikasi akademik.
a.en: Yes, international students may apply through the Indonesian Government's Developing Countries Partnership (KNB) Scholarship, bilateral governmental grants, or selective UNRAM tuition waiver programs based on academic excellence.

q.id: Bagaimana prosedur permohonan visa dan izin tinggal bagi mahasiswa asing?
q.en: What is the procedure for obtaining a student visa and stay permit?

a.id: Setelah diterima resmi, KUI UNRAM akan mengurus Rekomendasi Izin Belajar ke Kementerian. Selanjutnya, tim kami memandu proses permohonan e-Visa tinggal terbatas hingga kedatangan di Bandara Internasional Lombok.
a.en: Once admitted, OIA UNRAM assists in obtaining the mandatory Study Permit from the Ministry of Higher Education. We then guide you through the electronic limited-stay visa (e-ITAS) process prior to landing at Lombok International Airport.

q.id: Apakah tersedia akomodasi atau asrama mahasiswa di sekitar kampus UNRAM?
q.en: Is on-campus or student accommodation provided near the university?

a.id: UNRAM menyediakan Asrama Mahasiswa (Rusunawa) di dalam area kampus dan staf KUI siap mendampingi pencarian tempat tinggal alternatif seperti kos atau homestay yang aman dan terjangkau di sekitar Kota Mataram.
a.en: UNRAM provides campus dormitories (Rusunawa), and our office helps international students find verified, budget-friendly off-campus private rooms and homestays within safe walking distance.

q.id: Bagaimana mahasiswa UNRAM dapat mendaftar program pertukaran ke luar negeri (IISMA / Outbound)?
q.en: How can UNRAM domestic students apply for outbound exchange programs like IISMA?

a.id: Mahasiswa aktif UNRAM dapat memantau info seleksi di situs KUI, mengikuti workshop pembekalan, dan mengajukan rekomendasi resmi universitas ke kantor kami sebelum batas tenggat program nasional.
a.en: Enrolled UNRAM students can access eligibility guidelines on our portal, participate in preparation workshops, and request official institutional nomination letters from OIA UNRAM ahead of national deadlines.

q.id: Bahasa apa yang digunakan dalam proses perkuliahan untuk mahasiswa internasional?
q.en: What is the primary language of instruction for international students?

a.id: Tersedia kelas internasional berbahasa pengantar Inggris untuk program studi tertentu. Bagi program reguler, UNRAM menyediakan kursus Bahasa Indonesia bagi Penutur Asing (BIPA) secara intensif.
a.en: Select degree programs offer English-taught courses. For regular Indonesian-language tracks, UNRAM delivers intensive Indonesian Language for Foreign Speakers (BIPA) preparatory classes.

q.id: Bagaimana institusi luar negeri dapat menginisiasi penandatanganan MoU dengan UNRAM?
q.en: How can an overseas university or research body initiate an MoU with UNRAM?

a.id: Perwakilan institusi dapat mengirimkan draf proposal kerja sama dan surat pengantar melalui formulir kontak kami atau via email resmi KUI di io@unram.ac.id untuk ditindaklanjuti bagian hukum dan kerja sama.
a.en: Prospective institutions can submit a formal letter of intent and draft agreement via our contact form or directly to io@unram.ac.id for review by our Rectorate and Legal Partnerships bureau.

title.id: Penandatanganan Nota Kesepahaman Riset Bersama Konsorsium Internasional
title.en: Signing of Joint Marine & Environmental Research MoU with International Consortium

summary.id: UNRAM memperluas kolaborasi riset kelautan dan keanekaragaman hayati Lombok bersama perwakilan universitas mitra asing.
summary.en: UNRAM deepens collaborative research in marine conservation and tropical ecology with partner delegates from abroad.

content.id:
Universitas Mataram menandatangani Nota Kesepahaman (MoU) dan Perjanjian Kerja Sama Riset (MoA) dengan konsorsium universitas riset internasional terkemuka di bidang biologi kelautan dan kelestarian ekosistem terumbu karang.

Kolaborasi ini mencakup pendanaan hibah penelitian bersama, pertukaran profesor tamu, serta pemanfaatan stasiun laboratorium laut tropis UNRAM di pesisir Pulau Lombok. Inisiatif strategis ini diharapkan mempercepat hilirisasi publikasi saintifik internasional bereputasi dan memberikan solusi nyata bagi mitigasi perubahan iklim di wilayah pesisir Nusa Tenggara Barat.
content.en:
Universitas Mataram ratified a comprehensive Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) and research implementation agreement with an international consortium specializing in marine biotechnology and coral reef preservation.

The multilateral initiative unlocks collaborative research grants, reciprocal faculty fellowships, and field deployments at UNRAM's tropical marine research station in coastal Lombok. This strategic partnership directly bolsters high-impact global publications and community-driven climate resilience models across the Indonesian archipelago.

title.id: Penyambutan Mahasiswa Asing Program Indonesian Culture & Language
title.en: Welcoming Orientation for International Students of Indonesian Language & Culture Program

summary.id: KUI UNRAM menggelar sesi orientasi budaya, tata tertib kampus, serta kelas adaptasi bagi mahasiswa asing semester ini.
summary.en: OIA UNRAM delivered campus orientation, cultural adaptation briefings, and student welfare support for incoming international fellows.

content.id:
KUI Universitas Mataram menyambut hangat rombongan mahasiswa internasional baru dari berbagai negara seperti Jerman, Jepang, Korea Selatan, dan Timor Leste yang mengikuti program semesteran Bahasa Indonesia bagi Penutur Asing (BIPA) dan Studi Budaya Sasak.

Orientasi mencakup pengenalan sistem akademik digital SIAKAD, tata tertib kampus, panduan keselamatan lingkungan, serta pendampingan langsung oleh rekan mahasiswa UNRAM (Student Buddies) untuk membantu adaptasi di lingkungan masyarakat Mataram.
content.en:
OIA Universitas Mataram warmly welcomed incoming international students from Germany, Japan, South Korea, and Timor-Leste enrolled in the Indonesian Language for Foreign Speakers (BIPA) and Sasak Cultural Studies programs.

The onboarding program delivered comprehensive walkthroughs of campus academic portals, immigration protocol, student welfare amenities, and paired international candidates with local UNRAM Student Buddies to facilitate seamless cultural integration.
